related_work: The task we were given this week was to write a Access Rider, a document that described the individuals accessibility needs and requirements.
title: Module Introduction
introduction: This week was the introduction to the Creative Industry Research module. She talked about the research and how to choose a subject for this research in relation to 4 pillars, what I love, what I am good at, what the world needs and what you can be paid for. She talked about the role of the designer/practitioner/researcher, which is building theory through design, applying and extending. Some tips, one was to keep notes of everything and the second was that I am a practitioner. She also talked about "Autoethnography is a queer method."
